SELECT timestamp,source,
CASE WHEN source='edge_logs' THEN CASE WHEN position(log_attributes['request.path'],'/verifications/pickup/')>0 THEN 'pickup_photo_upload' WHEN position(log_attributes['request.path'],'/verifications/dropoff/')>0 THEN 'dropoff_photo_upload' WHEN position(log_attributes['request.path'],'/parcels/')>0 THEN 'booking_photo_upload' ELSE 'other_object_upload' END
WHEN source='postgres_logs' THEN CASE WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(log_attributes['parsed.query'],'realtime.subscription')>0 THEN 'Realtime_subscription' WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(log_attributes['parsed.query'],'list_changes')>0 THEN 'Realtime_list_changes' WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(log_attributes['parsed.query'],'riders')>0 THEN 'riders_query' ELSE 'other_SQL' END
ELSE 'storage_error' END AS operation,
log_attributes['response.status_code'] AS status,log_attributes['response.origin_time'] AS origin_ms,log_attributes['request.headers.content_length'] AS request_bytes,
log_attributes['parsed.application_name'] AS application_name,log_attributes['parsed.sql_state_code'] AS sqlstate,
CASE WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(event_message,'canceling statement due to statement timeout')>0 THEN 'statement_timeout' WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(event_message,'canceling statement due to user request')>0 THEN 'user_cancel' WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(event_message,'timeout')>0 THEN 'timeout' WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(event_message,'aborted')>0 THEN 'aborted' WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(event_message,'connection')>0 THEN 'connection_error' ELSE 'other' END AS error_class,
extract(event_message,'(ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|EPIPE|RequestAborted|DatabaseTimeout|57014|PGRST003)') AS safe_error_code,
arrayFilter(k->positionCaseInsensitive(k,'error')>0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(k,'duration')>0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(k,'time')>0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(k,'status')>0,mapKeys(log_attributes)) AS diagnostic_field_names
FROM logs WHERE (source='edge_logs' AND startsWith(log_attributes['request.path'],'/storage/') AND log_attributes['request.method'] IN('POST','PUT','PATCH') AND NOT startsWith(log_attributes['request.path'],'/storage/v1/object/sign/'))
OR(source='postgres_logs' AND log_attributes['parsed.sql_state_code']='57014')
OR(source='storage_logs' AND (positionCaseInsensitive(event_message,'error')>0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(event_message,'timeout')>0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(event_message,'aborted')>0))
ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 25
